# Task P6-02: Import-list providers — Deezer playlist, Deezer artist top tracks, YouTube Music playlist

**Phase:** 6 · **Depends on:** P6-01 (merged: the provider interface and the sync) · **Suggested tier:** T2 worker · **Estimated size:** M

## Goal

P6-01 built synced import lists and the CSV provider. This task adds three providers that read a service instead of a file (ADR-0012): a public **Deezer playlist**, an artist's **top tracks on Deezer**, and a public **YouTube Music playlist**. Each provider only reads its source and returns `ImportListEntry` rows in order; resolving, adding and scheduling are already done by `ImportListService` (P6-01). No UI (P6-05), no migration.

## Deliverables

### 1. Deezer (`src/Wondarr.Core/Metadata/Deezer/`, `src/Wondarr.Core/ImportLists/Deezer/`)

- `IDeezerClient` / `DeezerClient`: add, through the existing `GetBodyAsync`/`SendAsync` path (the cache, the quota handler, the no-data handling — read `DeezerClient.cs` lines 100–290 first):
  - `GetPlaylistTracksAsync(long playlistId, int index, int limit, ct)` → `GET playlist/{id}/tracks?index={index}&limit={limit}`; returns a page: the tracks (id, title, isrc, duration in seconds, artist name, album title) and `total`; `null` when Deezer answers "no data" (code 800 — an unknown or private playlist). Cache TTL 10 minutes (a playlist changes; a sync an hour later must see the change).
  - `GetArtistTopAsync(long artistId, int limit, ct)` → `GET artist/{id}/top?limit={limit}` (no ISRC in these rows — verified 2026-10-07); cache 1 day.
  - `SearchArtistsAsync(string name, int limit, ct)` → `GET search/artist?q={name}&limit={limit}` (id, name, `nb_fan`); cache 1 day.
  - Models in `DeezerModels.cs` (reuse `DeezerTrack` where its shape fits; check what it already has).
- `DeezerPlaylistProvider` (`Type = "deezerPlaylist"`, `DisplayName = "Deezer playlist"`): one field `playlist` (text, required; help: "A Deezer playlist link or id; the playlist must be public"). Accepts `https://www.deezer.com/playlist/908622995`, `https://www.deezer.com/en/playlist/908622995?…`, `deezer.com/playlist/…`, or a bare number; `Validate` refuses anything else (and a short link `deezer.page.link/…` with the message "Open the short link in a browser and paste the full playlist link"). `FetchAsync` pages with `limit = 100` (`index` 0, 100, 200, …) until a page is short or `index >= total`, at most 100 pages; each track → `ImportListEntry(ExternalId: "deezer:" + id, Artist, Title, Album, DurationMs: duration × 1000, Isrc, DeezerId: id)`. Unknown/private → `ImportListFetchResult.Failed("The Deezer playlist was not found, or it is private.")`.
- `DeezerArtistTopProvider` (`Type = "deezerArtistTop"`, `DisplayName = "Artist top tracks (Deezer)"`): fields `artist` (text, required; "An artist name, or a Deezer artist link or id") and `count` (number, required, 1–100, default 10). A link or id is used as is; a name is searched and the result whose name equals it (case-insensitive, after trimming) is taken, else the one with the most fans among the first five; none → `Failed("Deezer has no artist named '…'.")`. Entries as above, `ExternalId: "deezer:" + id`, no ISRC (the sync resolves by the Deezer id).
- Both registered as `IImportListProvider` **scoped** (they use `IDeezerClient`) in `src/Wondarr.Core/ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs` next to the CSV provider (which stays a singleton — `ImportListService` takes `IEnumerable<IImportListProvider>`, so mixing lifetimes is fine).

### 2. YouTube Music (`src/Wondarr.Sources.YouTube/`)

- `IInnertubeClient` / `InnertubeClient`: `BrowsePlaylistAsync(string playlistId, ct)` → all rows of the playlist. `POST youtubei/v1/browse?alt=json` with the same WEB_REMIX context and headers `SearchAsync` sends (copy its `Body` helper; the first request has `"browseId": "VL" + playlistId` — unless the id already starts with `VL` — and each next request `"continuation": token` instead). Page 1's rows are in `contents.twoColumnBrowseResultsRenderer.secondaryContents.sectionListRenderer.contents[0].musicPlaylistShelfRenderer.contents[]`; a continuation answer's rows are in `onResponseReceivedActions[0].appendContinuationItemsAction.continuationItems[]`. In both, a trailing `continuationItemRenderer.continuationEndpoint.continuationCommand.token` means there is another page (verified live 2026-10-07; fixtures below). At most 100 pages.
- Parsing (in `InnertubeResponseParser.cs` or a new `InnertubePlaylistParser.cs`), each `musicResponsiveListItemRenderer`: `flexColumns[0]` runs → title; `flexColumns[1]` runs → the artist credit (the runs' texts joined, e.g. "Luis Fonsi & Daddy Yankee"); `flexColumns[2]` runs → album (often empty); `fixedColumns[0]` → duration `m:ss` or `h:mm:ss`; `playlistItemData.videoId` → the id. A row without a `videoId` (an unavailable video) is skipped. Be defensive: a missing column is null, never an exception.
- `YouTubeMusicPlaylistProvider` (`Type = "youtubeMusicPlaylist"`, `DisplayName = "YouTube Music playlist"`): one field `playlist` (text, required; "A YouTube Music or YouTube playlist link, or its id; the playlist must be public or unlisted"). Accepts `https://music.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL…`, `https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=…`, a `watch?v=…&list=…` link (take `list`), or a bare id (letters, digits, `-`, `_`, 10–64 chars). Entries: `ImportListEntry(ExternalId: "ytm:" + videoId, Artist: the first artist run's text, Title, Album, DurationMs)` — no ISRC, so the sync resolves by text with the length check. An `InnertubeException` with 404/400 → `Failed("The YouTube Music playlist was not found, or it is private.")`; other failures surface as the sync's generic message (P6-01 maps exceptions).
- Register it as a scoped `IImportListProvider` in `src/Wondarr.Sources.YouTube/ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs`. Reading a playlist is metadata only: it does **not** depend on the YouTube source being enabled.

Charlie Puth)" / Wiz Khalifa / 3:58, "Shape of You" / Ed Sheeran / 4:24, then a continuation token) followed by the continuation request (assert its body carries `continuation` and no `browseId`) answered with `browse-playlist-PL15B1E77BB5708555-page2-last.json` (2 rows, the first "Dura" / Daddy Yankee / 3:38, no further token) → 5 rows in order; the provider's link parsing; a 404 → the "not found" failure.

## Constraints

- Every Deezer call goes through `DeezerClient`'s existing path (cache, quota handler); every InnerTube call through `InnertubeClient`'s `HttpClient`. No new `HttpClient`s.
- A provider never resolves, adds or deletes anything; it only reads.
- Never log a playlist's contents or the request bodies at Information.
- Build after adding new test files before running tests.

## Acceptance criteria (each must be demonstrated)

1. `dotnet build -warnaserror` and `dotnet test` green (whole solution).
2. The tests in §3 pass, including the two-page YouTube Music read and the Deezer paging stop conditions.
3. `GET /api/v1/importlist/schema` lists `csv`, `deezerPlaylist`, `deezerArtistTop`, `youtubeMusicPlaylist` (extend `tests/Wondarr.Api.Tests/ImportListApiTests.cs`' schema test — that file is in scope for this one assertion).
